what: Master Version 2.50 — Lionel PW - Items 850 (Row ID SCX2DBVKTP) removed. It was a hand-entered row (Source Manual, note "Preserved from live (Manual source — non-COTT)", no link) named "Range Target Set", while its Variation Details ("BLUE No. 850 U-DRIVE BOAT / U-DRIVE BOAT"), Body Color (blue) and COTT Code (SS0374) are the U-Drive boat's. No source anywhere (COTT, the reference book workbook, Greenberg price file, the web) shows a Lionel postwar O No. 850 Range Target Set; the name most likely strayed from Lionel's HO 0847 Exploding Target Range car / HO 0850 missile car (c. 1960; Lionel postwar HO is not in the master yet). The real No. 850 U-Drive Boat (1964, SS0374) stays on Lionel PW - Other (2Y3ZXAVZ75). Brad owns no 850 (checked 2026-10-17).
stated: Brad (2026-10-17): "yes" to looking at the 850, then "approve the delete"
